lead: Consultancy to buy the right land in the Lago Llanquihue and Malalcahuello basin. Territory first, asset second — each service is contracted independently.
priceNote: Prices in UF · subject to confirmation at your strategy session.
legal: We are not an estate agency or property portal. Every piece of land requires a specific assessment.

promo.title: Free diagnostic · 30% off search
promo.text: No obligation to buy more. If you want to continue, the search service is 3.5 UF.

gallery.eyebrow: More than a piece of land
gallery.phrase: This is what your future in southern Chile can look like — family, landscape and quality of life in areas with tourism potential. With the right land and our support, the investment feels like this too.

services.title: Strategic property diagnostic
deliverables: Report with recommended zones and evaluation criteria
Concrete next steps based on your budget and objective
notes: Ideal if you still do not know which zone to target or how to evaluate options.
services.promoNote: Until 30 September: free diagnostic with no obligation.

services.title: Personalised land search
deliverables: Selection of at least 4 land options aligned with your objective and budget
Session with you to rule out, reselect and define the 3 best options together
Comparison report on the 3 best alternatives selected with the client
notes: For buyers who want curated options, not a mass catalogue.
services.promoNote: Promotion: free diagnostic + search at 3.5 UF (was 5 UF) until 30 September.

services.title: Purchase advisory and acquisition support
deliverables: Coordination with notary and suppliers through to completion
notes: 5 UF less if you previously contracted personalised search.

services.title: Property potential study
services.objective: Objective: establish the commercial vocation of a piece of land, the optimal project and why.
deliverables: Report with territorial and regulatory analysis
Recommendation to proceed or not, with verifiable support
notes: Scope and final fee depend on land and project complexity.

services.title: Project structuring and development
deliverables: Roadmap for cabins, tourism, strip centre, retail or short-stay rental
notes: Territory and regulation before the business model.
